title: decode_rule255 profile ceiling also misclassified as retryable BufferTooSmall
description: Twin of project-LICHEN-worker6-5mbk (fixed encode_rule255; commit follows same session). decode_rule255 (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs, the data.len() > profile_limit check) returns BufferTooSmall::new(data.len(), profile_limit) for the profile/single-frame ceiling. Growing the caller's out buffer can never satisfy an input-side ceiling, so a grow-and-retry decode caller loop never terminates — same never-terminates defect class fixed on the encode side. The boundary test comment (rule255_profile_size_boundary) currently documents this decode behavior as intentional ('reports the profile overflow as a capacity error'); the public decompress() path already rejects it as terminal InvalidPacket("SCHC packet exceeds profile limit") before dispatch. Fix: classify the direct decode_rule255 ceiling as terminal (InvalidPacket or a dedicated variant), keep the out-capacity check retryable, update rule255_profile_size_boundary expectations, keep parity with Python's terminal rejection.
close_reason: 已实现：decode_rule255 profile-ceiling 由可重试 BufferTooSmall 改为终止 SchcError::InvalidPacket("Rule 255 packet exceeds profile single-frame limit")（镜像 encode 侧 5mbk 修复与 Python 终端语义）；out-capacity 检查保持可重试 BufferTooSmall。测试 rule255_profile_size_boundary 更新：over-ceiling 探针断言终止错误、新增 sub-ceiling single_frame_limit 终止探针、decompress() 前置拦截不变、short-out 容量错误保持可重试。cargo test -p lichen-schc 92+全部集成套件绿；clippy 无警告；rustfmt 通过。3x codereview：security 委派 reviewer 模型 PASS；correctness/edge-cases 委派超时(rc=124)按协议 fallback 自审 PASS，零新发现。
